body:
Your tools are the Harness tools. Where instructions name Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, Bash, Glob, Grep, LS, or Task, use read_file, write_file, edit_file, bash, glob, grep, ls, or task. Where they name BashOutput, KillShell, or Bash with run_in_background, use process. There is no TodoWrite or Skill tool, and no WebFetch or WebSearch tool unless the session offers web_fetch or web_search. To use a skill, read its SKILL.md file with read_file.

Available skills. Each skill below is a capability you can use, but only its name and description are shown here. To activate a skill you MUST first read its SKILL.md file with the read_file tool before relying on it; do not assume its contents from the description alone.
picked — Scanned. (path: <workdir>/custom/picked/SKILL.md)
